title: expectrail.verify-timing/v1
description: Where the wall time of one verification went. Written by agents.verifier beside verification.json; it never feeds a decision. The four phases add up to the total: evaluate is the total less the harness's own time.

clock.description: Wall time on the machine that ran it.

import.description: Godot's --import, and warming the shared import cache when it is cold.

replay.description: The Godot process that plays the route and writes the frames and the trace.

evaluate.description: Everything the verifier does outside a harness run: observations, the checks, the verdict files.

other.description: The harness outside Godot: copying the game, applying patches, hashing the frames.

arms.description: One entry per replay the verifier asked for, in the order they first ran. A private route is named by its position, never by its name.

harnessRuns.description: More than one when a replay was retried.

decision.description: The verification's decision, so a timing is not read without its outcome.

sam.description: Whether the SAM specs were judged; they add model calls to evaluate.
